dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Primary central O-shaped annulus with a jagged, high-contrast white boundary; secondary smaller circular ring dorsal-anterior to the center; multiple C-shaped arcs on the posterior flank with thin white perimeters and dark interiors.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, non-gradient white pixel clusters localized along the dorsal ridge and anterior neck region, appearing as high-contrast irregular patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the largest central O-ring, the smaller dorsal-anterior O-ring, and the largest posterior-lateral ring form an asymmetrical scalene triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive reticulated mesh-like pattern across the flank, resulting from the dense intersection of thin, high-contrast lines connecting various annuli.
